prompts.forest: Create a finished 2D hand-drawn indie platformer BACKGROUND environment painting, landscape 16:10, for a 960x600 single-screen arena. Scene: warm late-afternoon woodland clearing, large ochre-brown tree trunks on far left and far right, sage green distant foliage, rolling mossy hills low in frame, small pale flowers and ferns only at bottom corners, golden sunbeams through the canopy. Art direction: soft colored-pencil outlines, matte gouache color shapes, subtle dry pastel texture, charming picture-book illustration, sophisticated cohesive color palette. Clear foreground/background depth, atmospheric perspective and gentle light. Playable characters will be pasted on top separately. KEEP CENTER 70% QUIET AND OPEN for clear combat readability; environment detail concentrated along outer sides, top edge and bottom edge. No characters, no animals, no food, no text, no logos, no UI, no floating islands, no gameplay platforms or steps. Beautiful finished illustration rather than a vector diagram. Entire canvas opaque.
